task.title: Multi-Camera Switching
task.shortdesc: Switch live between multiple camera sources with dedicated preview tiles.

context.p: The Multi-Camera panel shows a live preview tile for every camera source in the current scene at once, letting you cut between them without hunting through the Sources list.

step.cmd: Open the Multi-Camera panel from the Docks menu.
Assign a numbered slot to each camera source you want quick access to.
Click a tile, or press its assigned number key, to bring that camera to Program.

taskbody.result: The selected camera becomes the active video source with the currently configured transition.
